key: You shoulda seen this place before the water cleared up.
en: You shoulda seen this place before the water cleared up.
ja: 水がきれいになる前のここ、見せてやりたかったぜ。

key: We'd clean up the walls, and then they'd just be grimy again the next day.
en: We'd clean up the walls, and then they'd just be grimy again the next day.
ja: 壁を掃除しても、次の日にはまた汚れちまうんだ。

key: What a nightmare. I'm thankful it pulled together.
en: What a nightmare. I'm thankful it pulled together.
ja: まさに悪夢だったよ。まとまってくれて感謝してる。

key: Don't take this the wrong way, because I'm glad the city's looking better now.
en: Don't take this the wrong way, because I'm glad the city's looking better now.
ja: 誤解しないでくれよ、街が良くなったのはうれしいんだ。

key: But on the real, it doesn't feel the same.
en: But on the real, it doesn't feel the same.
ja: でもマジな話、前とは同じ感じがしないんだよな。

key: We used to own these streets. Now everything's wrapped up in order and perfection.
en: We used to own these streets. Now everything's wrapped up in order and perfection.
ja: 昔はこの通りは俺たちのものだった。今は何もかも秩序と完璧さに包まれちまってる。

key: No thanks.
en: No thanks.
ja: 遠慮しとくよ。

key: This city is still far from the technological paradise I dream of...
en: This city is still far from the technological paradise I dream of...
ja: この街はまだ、俺が夢見る技術の楽園には程遠いな……

key: But it'll do for the time being.
en: But it'll do for the time being.
ja: でも当面はこれでいいだろう。

key: So much to do now! Houses to refurnish, a new market to visit, and I still have work tomorrow!
en: So much to do now! Houses to refurnish, a new market to visit, and I still have work tomorrow!
ja: やることが山積みだよ!家具の入れ替えに、新しい市場にも行かなきゃだし、明日は仕事もあるし!

key: Who knew that all it would take to make the plants here bloom again was clean water and some Pokémon magic?
en: Who knew that all it would take to make the plants here bloom again was clean water and some Pokémon magic?
ja: ここの植物をまた咲かせるのに必要だったのは、きれいな水とポケモンの力だけだったなんてな。

key: And a bit of elbow grease, of course!
en: And a bit of elbow grease, of course!
ja: あとはもちろん、ちょっとした苦労もね!

key: turbo thrusters: ACTIVATE
en: turbo thrusters: ACTIVATE
ja: ターボスラスター:起動

key: Hey, Trainer. We fought before, right?
en: Hey, Trainer. We fought before, right?
ja: よう、トレーナー。前に戦ったよな?

key: You only had one Badge then. And now?
en: You only had one Badge then. And now?
ja: あの時はバッジひとつだけだったろ。それで今は?

key: Sheesh.
en: Sheesh.
ja: やれやれ。

key: Makes me feel a little better about getting thrashed.
en: Makes me feel a little better about getting thrashed.
ja: ボコられたのも、ちょっとは救われる気がするよ。

key: If only I had known.
en: If only I had known.
ja: 知ってたらな。

key: This city was always marvelous beneath the surface.
en: This city was always marvelous beneath the surface.
ja: この街は、表面の下ではずっと素晴らしいものを持ってたんだ。

key: It only took everyone's help to bring it out into the light.
en: It only took everyone's help to bring it out into the light.
ja: それを光の下に引き出すには、みんなの力が必要だっただけさ。

key: To go some place far away...
en: To go some place far away...
ja: どこか遠い場所に行くの……

key: That sounds nice.
en: That sounds nice.
ja: 素敵に聞こえるわね。

key: I want to go somewhere with open seas, shining sun...
en: I want to go somewhere with open seas, shining sun...
ja: 開けた海と輝く太陽のある場所に行きたいの……

key: And most importantly, you, my darling.
en: And most importantly, you, my darling.
ja: それに何より、あなたと一緒にね、ダーリン。

key: After the Grandview Station reopens, let's leave this place.
en: After the Grandview Station reopens, let's leave this place.
ja: グランドビュー駅が再開したら、ここを離れましょう。

key: I never realized how much I wanted to leave until I wasn't able to.
en: I never realized how much I wanted to leave until I wasn't able to.
ja: 出られなくなるまで、こんなに離れたかったなんて気づかなかったわ。

key: Now that I can again, I don't want to miss that chance.
en: Now that I can again, I don't want to miss that chance.
ja: また出られるようになった今、そのチャンスを逃したくないの。

key: Imagine being able to make an entirely rebuilt city in such a short amount of time...
en: Imagine being able to make an entirely rebuilt city in such a short amount of time...
ja: こんな短期間で街をまるごと作り直せるなんてな……

key: The power of technology is incredible!
en: The power of technology is incredible!
ja: 技術の力ってすごいな!

key: Trainer, would you like to hear something fascinating?
en: Trainer, would you like to hear something fascinating?
ja: トレーナー、面白い話を聞きたいか?

key: For a long time, I've been researching Hidden Abilities.
en: For a long time, I've been researching Hidden Abilities.
ja: 長いこと、隠れ特性について研究してるんだ。

key: In most regions, it's very rare that Pokémon in the wild have different Abilities, but in Reborn, it's almost commonplace.
en: In most regions, it's very rare that Pokémon in the wild have different Abilities, but in Reborn, it's almost commonplace.
ja: たいていの地方では、野生のポケモンが違う特性を持つのはとても珍しいことだが、リボーンではほとんど当たり前なんだ。

key: I wanted to know, why?
en: I wanted to know, why?
ja: なぜなのか知りたかった。

key: The truth is, I still haven't found an answer.
en: The truth is, I still haven't found an answer.
ja: 正直なところ、まだ答えは見つかってない。

key: For a while, my hypothesis was that pollution and radiation from Reborn City was prompting rogue genetic mutations in Pokémon of all kinds.
en: For a while, my hypothesis was that pollution and radiation from Reborn City was prompting rogue genetic mutations in Pokémon of all kinds.
ja: しばらくは、リボーンシティの汚染と放射線が、あらゆる種類のポケモンに突発的な遺伝子変異を引き起こしているという仮説を立てていた。

key: This renovation project provided the perfect chance to test this.
en: This renovation project provided the perfect chance to test this.
ja: 今回の再開発計画は、それを検証する絶好の機会になった。

key: After all, we've closed most of the wasteful factories, and cleaned up our act significantly.
en: After all, we've closed most of the wasteful factories, and cleaned up our act significantly.
ja: なにせ、無駄の多い工場のほとんどを閉鎖して、大幅にきれいになったからな。

key: By now, Reborn produces only a small bit more pollution than any other major city.
en: By now, Reborn produces only a small bit more pollution than any other major city.
ja: 今ではリボーンが出す汚染も、他の大都市とほとんど変わらないくらいだ。

key: If my theory were correct, then we should have seen a decline in the number of Pokémon with alternate Abilities and coloration.
en: If my theory were correct, then we should have seen a decline in the number of Pokémon with alternate Abilities and coloration.
ja: 俺の説が正しければ、異なる特性や色違いのポケモンの数が減っているはずだった。

key: But surprisingly, nothing with regards to that has changed!
en: But surprisingly, nothing with regards to that has changed!
ja: だが驚いたことに、その点については何も変わっていない!

key: Even among newborn Pokémon, the difference in mutations between then and now is statistically insignificant.
en: Even among newborn Pokémon, the difference in mutations between then and now is statistically insignificant.
ja: 生まれたばかりのポケモンでも、当時と今とで変異の差は統計的に見て誤差の範囲だ。

key: So, I must find a new hypothesis.
en: So, I must find a new hypothesis.
ja: だから、新しい仮説を見つけないといけない。

key: Could past radiation produce lingering epigenetic changes? Could there be some other energy source hidden near the city?
en: Could past radiation produce lingering epigenetic changes? Could there be some other energy source hidden near the city?
ja: 過去の放射線が、エピジェネティックな変化を残しているんだろうか?それとも街の近くに何か別のエネルギー源が隠れているのか?

key: Maybe it could even be the work of a legendary Pokémon! Arceus or Rayquaza, for instance!
en: Maybe it could even be the work of a legendary Pokémon! Arceus or Rayquaza, for instance!
ja: もしかしたら伝説のポケモンの仕業かもしれない!例えばアルセウスとかレックウザとかな!

key: No matter the case, I will definitely find the answer one day!
en: No matter the case, I will definitely find the answer one day!
ja: どんな場合でも、いつか必ず答えを見つけてやる!

key: For a long time, I've been researching Hidden-- Oh, what? You don't?
en: For a long time, I've been researching Hidden-- Oh, what? You don't?
ja: 長いこと、隠れ……ああ、なんだ?興味ない?

key: Well, uh... Okay.
en: Well, uh... Okay.
ja: あ、えっと……わかった。

key: Can you hear the voices?
en: Can you hear the voices?
ja: 声が聞こえるか?

key: "Thank you", they command me to whisper, "For everything."
en: "Thank you", they command me to whisper, "For everything."
ja: 「ありがとう」と、彼らは私にささやくよう命じる。「すべてに」と。

key: <>- Grandview Avenue\n^ - Opal Bridge
en: <>- Grandview Avenue\n^ - Opal Bridge
ja: <>- グランドビューアベニュー\n^ - オパール大橋

key: TESLA: Oh, are you on a stroll through the Opal Ward too?
en: TESLA: Oh, are you on a stroll through the Opal Ward too?
ja: テスラ:あら、あなたもオパール区をお散歩中?

key: I'm here for some work and I decided it'd be fun to turn the experience into a mini vacation with my family!
en: I'm here for some work and I decided it'd be fun to turn the experience into a mini vacation with my family!
ja: 仕事でこっちに来てるんだけど、家族とのちょっとした休暇にしたら楽しいかなって思って!

key: My family being my little girl, Amber.
en: My family being my little girl, Amber.
ja: 家族っていうのは、うちの娘のアンバーのことよ。

key: AMBER: I'm not little anymore... I'm twelve now, you don't have to baby me!
en: AMBER: I'm not little anymore... I'm twelve now, you don't have to baby me!
ja: アンバー:あたし、もう子供じゃないもん……もう12歳なんだから、赤ちゃん扱いしないでよ!

key: I wish Dad was here...
en: I wish Dad was here...
ja: パパもここにいてくれたらな……

key: TESLA: Yes, your father would have a nice time for once if he wasn't so obsessed trying to cause trouble...
en: TESLA: Yes, your father would have a nice time for once if he wasn't so obsessed trying to cause trouble...
ja: テスラ:そうね、パパもトラブルを起こすことばかり考えてなければ、たまには楽しめたでしょうに……

key: That man... I don't know what I'm going to do with him.
en: That man... I don't know what I'm going to do with him.
ja: まったくあの人には……どうしたらいいのかしら。

key: Oh, I'm so sorry to take up your time with all this nonsense!
en: Oh, I'm so sorry to take up your time with all this nonsense!
ja: あら、こんなくだらない話でお時間を取らせてしまってごめんなさいね!

key: Let me treat you to something for all of that... Hm.... Let's see...
en: Let me treat you to something for all of that... Hm.... Let's see...
ja: おわびに何かごちそうさせて……そうね……何がいいかしら……

key: TESLA: Ah-hah!
en: TESLA: Ah-hah!
ja: テスラ:あ、そうだ!

key: The vendor down by Obsidia gave me an extra bit of cotton candy by mistake.
en: The vendor down by Obsidia gave me an extra bit of cotton candy by mistake.
ja: オブシディアの露店の人が、間違えて綿あめを余分にくれたのよ。

key: Here, you can have it!
en: Here, you can have it!
ja: はい、これあげるわね!

key: TESLA: Please, have a wonderful rest of your day~!
en: TESLA: Please, have a wonderful rest of your day~!
ja: テスラ:どうか、残りの一日も素敵に過ごしてね~!

key: TESLA: You look like you've been traveling for ages, hun...
en: TESLA: You look like you've been traveling for ages, hun...
ja: テスラ:ずいぶん長く旅をしてきたみたいね、あなた……

key: You better make sure you're eating properly-- And hydrating as much as possible!
en: You better make sure you're eating properly-- And hydrating as much as possible!
ja: ちゃんとご飯を食べてる?水分もできるだけ取らないとダメよ!

key: Also getting enough sleep. It's good for your skin and mental health!
en: Also getting enough sleep. It's good for your skin and mental health!
ja: 睡眠もしっかりね。お肌にも心にもいいんだから!

key: And make sure you're taking your vitamins too--
en: And make sure you're taking your vitamins too--
ja: それにビタミンもちゃんと摂らないと――

key: AMBER: Mom... Give it a rest. They didn't ask for your advice...
en: AMBER: Mom... Give it a rest. They didn't ask for your advice...
ja: アンバー:ママ……もうやめてよ。誰もアドバイスなんて頼んでないのに……

key: TESLA: Oh, true! I'm so sorry! I can get carried away pretty easily...
en: TESLA: Oh, true! I'm so sorry! I can get carried away pretty easily...
ja: テスラ:あら、そうね!ごめんなさい!すぐ夢中になっちゃうのよね……

key: Please have a wonderful day!
en: Please have a wonderful day!
ja: 素敵な一日を!

key: Hey there! Can I interest you in some ice cream?
en: Hey there! Can I interest you in some ice cream?
ja: ねえ!アイスクリームなんてどう?

key: AMBER: ...
en: AMBER: ...
ja: アンバー:……

key: Can I help you with something?
en: Can I help you with something?
ja: 何か用?

key: TESLA: Amber, don't be rude!
en: TESLA: Amber, don't be rude!
ja: テスラ:アンバー、失礼でしょ!

key: AMBER: I'm the rude one? This adult is the one talking to a child...
en: AMBER: I'm the rude one? This adult is the one talking to a child...
ja: アンバー:あたしが失礼なの?この大人が子供に話しかけてるんじゃない……

key: TESLA: I'm sure they mean well.
en: TESLA: I'm sure they mean well.
ja: テスラ:きっと悪気はないのよ。

key: AMBER: Sure...
en: AMBER: Sure...
ja: アンバー:はいはい……

key: Anyway, I'm Amber. I wanna go home.
en: Anyway, I'm Amber. I wanna go home.
ja: とにかく、あたしはアンバー。家に帰りたい。

key: TESLA: But we just got here...
en: TESLA: But we just got here...
ja: テスラ:でも来たばかりじゃない……

key: AMBER: Yeah, but it's like... I don't know this place, y'know?
en: AMBER: Yeah, but it's like... I don't know this place, y'know?
ja: アンバー:うん、でもさ……ここどんなとこか知らないし、わかる?

key: I've never been this far from the resort. I dunno, I just wanna go home.
en: I've never been this far from the resort. I dunno, I just wanna go home.
ja: リゾートからこんなに離れたの初めてだもん。よくわかんないけど、とにかく帰りたいの。

key: TESLA: That's the fun about visiting somewhere new!
en: TESLA: That's the fun about visiting somewhere new!
ja: テスラ:それが新しい場所を訪れる楽しさなのよ!

key: You can explore and see the sights...
en: You can explore and see the sights...
ja: 探検して、景色を見てまわって……

key: Find foods you've never even heard of! The sky's the limit, dear!
en: Find foods you've never even heard of! The sky's the limit, dear!
ja: 聞いたこともない食べ物を見つけたり!可能性は無限大よ、あなた!

key: AMBER: I am pretty hungry... All I've had were Red Hots from that candy store.
en: AMBER: I am pretty hungry... All I've had were Red Hots from that candy store.
ja: アンバー:お腹はすいてるけど……あのお菓子屋さんのレッドホットしか食べてないし。

key: They were fine and all, but I want actual food.
en: They were fine and all, but I want actual food.
ja: 別に嫌じゃなかったけど、ちゃんとしたご飯が食べたいの。

key: TESLA: Okay! We can go somewhere soon! Your choice, okay?
en: TESLA: Okay! We can go somewhere soon! Your choice, okay?
ja: テスラ:わかったわ!すぐどこかに行きましょう!あなたが選んでいいから、ね?

key: AMBER: We passed this place that looked kinda good...
en: AMBER: We passed this place that looked kinda good...
ja: アンバー:さっき通った、ちょっと良さそうなお店があったんだけど……

key: I think it was called the "The Spyce" or something like that.
en: I think it was called the "The Spyce" or something like that.
ja: たしか「スパイス」とかいう名前だった気がする。

key: TESLA: Let's have a nice meal there then. That sounds great.
en: TESLA: Let's have a nice meal there then. That sounds great.
ja: テスラ:じゃあそこで食事にしましょう。良さそうね。

key: AMBER: Hm... Okay! That sounds nice... Thanks, Mom!
en: AMBER: Hm... Okay! That sounds nice... Thanks, Mom!
ja: アンバー:うーん……わかった!いいかも……ありがとう、ママ!

key: Oh, sorry but you can't come with. This is for me and my mom only.
en: Oh, sorry but you can't come with. This is for me and my mom only.
ja: あ、悪いけどあんたは一緒に来れないから。これはあたしとママだけのだから。

key: TESLA: Oh Amber... Please don't be so rude all the time.
en: TESLA: Oh Amber... Please don't be so rude all the time.
ja: テスラ:アンバーったら……いつもそんなに失礼な態度取らないで。

key: AMBER: Hey, I'm not rude to you! Most of the time...
en: AMBER: Hey, I'm not rude to you! Most of the time...
ja: アンバー:ちょっと、ママには失礼にしてないでしょ!……たいていは。

key: I just don't trust anyone else, that's all. Don't take it so personally.
en: I just don't trust anyone else, that's all. Don't take it so personally.
ja: あたしはただ、他の人を信用してないだけ。そんなに気にしないでよ。

key: TESLA: Sigh...
en: TESLA: Sigh...
ja: テスラ:はぁ……

key: KIXUR: We're on a quest to build the perfect city!
en: KIXUR: We're on a quest to build the perfect city!
ja: キクサー:俺たちは完璧な街を作る旅の途中なんだ!

key: Always happy to help when I can, stranger.
en: Always happy to help when I can, stranger.
ja: できることがあれば、いつでも喜んで手伝うぜ、そこの人。

key: If we all do just a little bit of that here and there, maybe we'll find a world worth sticking around for yet.
en: If we all do just a little bit of that here and there, maybe we'll find a world worth sticking around for yet.
ja: みんながちょっとずつでもそういうことをしていけば、いつか居続ける価値のある世界が見つかるかもしれないな。

key: "Here lies inscribed the names of the many hands who helped to sculpt our city..."
en: "Here lies inscribed the names of the many hands who helped to sculpt our city..."
ja: 「ここには、我らが街を築くのに力を貸してくれた、多くの人々の名が刻まれている……」

key: Read?
en: Read?
ja: 読みますか?

key: Hello, totally random trainer. Please, take a moment and stop by Spinel Museum's gift shop.
en: Hello, totally random trainer. Please, take a moment and stop by Spinel Museum's gift shop.
ja: やあ、見知らぬトレーナーさん。ちょっと時間を取って、スピネル博物館のギフトショップに寄ってみてくれ。

key: We have fossils for trainers just like you! We also have type boosting items like...
en: We have fossils for trainers just like you! We also have type boosting items like...
ja: あんたみたいなトレーナーのために化石もそろえてるぞ!それにタイプ強化アイテムも……

key: ...Let's see here... charcoal, magnets, sunglasses... I don't believe these work... I mean, please stop by.
en: ...Let's see here... charcoal, magnets, sunglasses...  I don't believe these work... I mean, please stop by.
ja: ……えーと……もくたん、じしゃく、サングラス……効果あるのか怪しいけどな……とにかく、寄ってくれよ。

key: \PN picked up the package of Power Items!
en: \PN picked up the package of Power Items!
ja: \PNはパワーアイテムのセットを手に入れた!

key: You take care of yourself.
en: You take care of yourself.
ja: 自分の身体を大事にしなさい。

key: Actually, no.
en: Actually, no.
ja: いや、違うな。

key: You take care of Reborn.
en: You take care of Reborn.
ja: あんたがリボーンの面倒を見るんだ。

key: Reborn will take care of you.
en: Reborn will take care of you.
ja: そうすれば、リボーンがあんたの面倒を見てくれる。

key: Hey, haven't we crashed into each other before?
en: Hey, haven't we crashed into each other before?
ja: よう、前にどこかでぶつかったことあったよな?

key: Oh yeah. That's right, I saw you when you first got your Pokémon.
en: Oh yeah. That's right, I saw you when you first got your Pokémon.
ja: ああ、そうだ。あんたが初めてポケモンをもらった時に会ったんだ。

key: Looks like you've grown quite a bit since then.
en: Looks like you've grown quite a bit since then.
ja: あれからずいぶん成長したみたいだな。

key: But I guess this whole city has.
en: But I guess this whole city has.
ja: まあ、この街全体もそうか。

key: That's not a coincidence, is it?
en: That's not a coincidence, is it?
ja: 偶然じゃないよな?

key: Hey, wow! Like, you would have never believed it-- how everyone came together to make this place great!
en: Hey, wow! Like, you would have never believed it-- how everyone came together to make this place great!
ja: いやー、マジで!信じられないよな――みんなが力を合わせてこの場所を素晴らしくしたなんてさ!

key: It's totally changed my whole outlook on people!
en: It's totally changed my whole outlook on people!
ja: 人に対する考え方が、すっかり変わっちまったよ!

key: Before, I would've called myself crazy if I'd said that this place could actually be pretty.
en: Before, I would've called myself crazy if I'd said that this place could actually be pretty.
ja: 前だったら、この場所がきれいになるなんて言ったら、自分を頭おかしいって思っただろうな。

key: And look at it now.
en: And look at it now.
ja: それが今じゃこれだ。

key: People-watching's always better with a clean backdrop.
en: People-watching's always better with a clean backdrop.
ja: 人間観察も、背景がきれいだと格別だよな。

key: Maybe it's about time for me to stop watching and start doing.
en: Maybe it's about time for me to stop watching and start doing.
ja: 俺もそろそろ、見てるだけじゃなくて動き出す時かもな。

key: In fact...
en: In fact...
ja: というか……

key: See ya.
en: See ya.
ja: またな。

key: LILLIPUP: Liiiii... Ruff!
en: LILLIPUP: Liiiii... Ruff!
ja: ヨーテリー: ヨーーー……　ワン!

key: Lillipup ran away again!
en: Lillipup ran away again!
ja: ヨーテリーは また 逃げていった!

key: Ah, it's you!
en: Ah, it's you!
ja: ああ、あんたか!

key: You were that really strong Trainer who whomped me before to save that Pokémon, right?
en: You were that really strong Trainer who whomped me before to save that Pokémon, right?
ja: 前に、あのポケモンを助けるために俺をボコボコにした、あのめちゃくちゃ強いトレーナーだよな?

key: Man, I'm kinda glad you did, not gonna lie!
en: Man, I'm kinda glad you did, not gonna lie!
ja: いやマジで、あんたがそうしてくれてよかったよ、正直な話!

key: To tell the truth, I wasn't really comfortable with what they were doing, but I didn't have the confidence to stand up to them before.
en: To tell the truth, I wasn't really comfortable with what they were doing, but I didn't have the confidence to stand up to them before.
ja: 実を言うと、あいつらのやってることには前から違和感があったんだけど、立ち向かう自信がなかったんだ。

key: Just because you can't afford Poké Balls doesn't mean you should just bully Pokémon into doing whatever you want.
en: Just because you can't afford Poké Balls doesn't mean you should just bully Pokémon into doing whatever you want.
ja: モンスターボールが買えないからって、ポケモンをいじめて言いなりにさせていいわけじゃないよな。

key: I tried to get them to realize that afterwards, but they got pissed and stopped hanging out with me.
en: I tried to get them to realize that afterwards, but they got pissed and stopped hanging out with me.
ja: あの後、それをわからせようとしたんだけど、あいつらキレて俺と絶交しちまった。

key: Can't say I miss 'em.
en: Can't say I miss 'em.
ja: 別に寂しくもないけどな。

key: Truly, I'm tired of moving around all the time.
en: Truly, I'm tired of moving around all the time.
ja: 正直、ずっと動き回るのにはもう疲れたよ。

key: This city has become a fine place for me to live out my days.
en: This city has become a fine place for me to live out my days.
ja: この街は、俺が余生を過ごすにはいい場所になったな。

key: I will have no regrets.
en: I will have no regrets.
ja: 悔いはないさ。

key: You know what's kept the city afloat this whole time?
en: You know what's kept the city afloat this whole time?
ja: この街をずっと支えてきたもの、わかるか?

key: That's right: Electromagnetism.
en: That's right: Electromagnetism.
ja: そう、電磁気学だ。

key: ~ I've hoped for change and it gets better every day ~
en: ~ I've hoped for change and it gets better every day ~
ja: ~変化を望んで、日々良くなっていく~

key: ~ I've hoped for change, and now nothing is the same ~
en: ~ I've hoped for change, and now nothing is the same ~
ja: ~変化を望んで、今はもう何もかも違う~

key: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff! Rrrrrr!
en: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff! Rrrrrr!
ja: ヨーテリー: ワン! ワン! ウゥゥゥ!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
